decisions.reason: As a 2024 extension of the core practice software, it fits the firm's digital-integration strategy and recent development spending, so management is likely to continue it and treat any weak early uptake as temporary despite its lower public visibility.

Because it was newly launched in 2024, given its own webpage, and strongly supports the firm's publicly stated move toward more digital and integrated clinic workflows, management is likely to stay committed and justify further support rather than withdraw it quickly.
